content.user_title: Check Landing Page Experience Before Campaign Launch
content.value_statement: Ads can lose relevance when landing pages do not match their promises or work well on mobile. This skill produces a five-check preflight report with specific pass, partial, and fix actions.
actual_capabilities: Compares ad headlines and hooks with the page offer, price, discount, and product wording.
Checks whether the promised offer and primary call to action appear above the fold.
Reviews measured speed data or clearly labels a visual speed assessment as estimated.
Counts required form fields and identifies specific friction points.
Checks narrow-viewport readability, horizontal scrolling, tap targets, offer visibility, and form rendering.
Marks each check as Pass, Partial, or Fix and routes repairs to the appropriate workflow.
limitations: It does not rewrite page copy, redesign layouts, modify forms, or calculate an account score.
A continuity verdict requires both ad copy and landing page content.
Speed and mobile findings remain estimates without PageSpeed, CrUX, or rendered mobile evidence.
Optional rendered-page retrieval runs an external Python connector and makes network requests.

use_cases.title: Prelaunch Campaign Review
use_cases.description: Validate ad promises, offer visibility, forms, speed evidence, and mobile presentation before activating paid traffic.

use_cases.title: Landing Experience Diagnosis
use_cases.description: Identify likely causes of a below-average landing-page-experience rating without changing the page.

use_cases.title: Client Quality Assurance
use_cases.description: Create a consistent pass, partial, and fix report for each campaign destination.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Basic Preflight
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this landing page: [URL]. Check offer visibility, the primary CTA, form friction, mobile rendering, and available speed evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when you need a simple page-only review.

prompt_templates.title: Check Ad Message Match
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare this ad copy with the landing page: [ad copy] and [URL]. Mark every promise as Pass, Partial, or Fix.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use before launching ads with approved headlines and hooks.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose a Low Experience Rating
prompt_templates.prompt: The landing-page-experience rating is below average. Review [URL] against [ad copy], then identify which of the five checks likely failed.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when campaign reporting indicates weak landing page relevance.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Evidence-Labeled Launch Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Preflight [URL] against [ad copy] for the [profile] goal. Label every metric Measured, User-provided, or Estimated, and route each Fix to one owner.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for an advanced launch review with traceable evidence and handoffs.

output_examples.input: Check a page where the ad promises a 20 percent discount, but the first viewport only shows the product name.
output: Message match: Fix. The advertisement promises a 20 percent discount, but the page does not confirm it.
Above the fold: Fix. The first viewport omits the discount and does not support the advertisement promise.
Next action: Route offer wording and first-viewport changes to the landing page owner.

output_examples.input: Review a lead page with eight required fields and no mobile render evidence.
output: Form friction: Fix. Eight required fields create unnecessary completion effort.
Mobile render: Partial. No measured mobile render was provided, so this check remains Estimated.
Next action: Review removable fields and collect a measured narrow-viewport render.

output_examples.input: Preflight a page whose headline repeats the ad offer and whose measured mobile data shows acceptable loading.
output: Message match: Pass. The page headline echoes the advertisement offer.
Speed: Pass. The supplied mobile evidence is labeled Measured.
Launch status: Continue after confirming the CTA, form, and remaining mobile checks.

best_practices: Provide the exact live ad copy, destination URL, promised offer, and campaign goal.
Supply measured PageSpeed, CrUX, or mobile-render evidence when speed and rendering accuracy matter.
Confirm each Fix names one observable gap and one responsible owner.
anti_patterns: Do not request a continuity verdict when neither ad copy nor page content is available.
Do not present estimated speed or mobile observations as measured results.
Do not use this skill to rewrite copy, redesign forms, or calculate account-level scores.

faq.question: What does the skill check?
faq.answer: It checks message match, above-the-fold offer visibility, speed evidence, form friction, and mobile rendering.

faq.question: Does it change the landing page?
faq.answer: No. It identifies specific gaps and routes repairs to the responsible workflow.

faq.question: What inputs are required?
faq.answer: Provide the destination URL or page copy, the matching ad copy, the promised offer, and the campaign goal.

faq.question: Can it work without page speed data?
faq.answer: Yes. It labels speed and mobile observations as Estimated instead of inventing measured values.

faq.question: Does it fetch the landing page automatically?
faq.answer: It can use an optional external connector. Network retrieval should occur only after URL validation and user confirmation.

faq.question: What does the final report contain?
faq.answer: It contains five Pass, Partial, or Fix results, evidence labels, specific gaps, and one owner for each repair.
